title: Environment binding
description: Binds one workload definition to one environment (FR-36). The binding references a workload by name and supplies only what differs between environments. It cannot restate the workload's scope: no selection property exists here, so a second environment is a new binding rather than a second copy of the workload, and the two cannot drift apart.

name.description: Names this binding. Distinct from the workload it binds, so the same workload can carry several bindings.

environmentRef.description: Names an environment declared in the framework configuration. That the environment exists is a semantic check.

workloadRef.description: Names a workload declared in the framework configuration. The workload's scope selection lives there and only there. This is the mechanism that makes 'without duplicating the workload definition' structural rather than a convention (FR-36).

tier.description: The two tiers FR-36 requires at minimum. An enumeration rather than free text, so a typo produces a validation failure instead of a third tier nobody declared.

observationPeriodOverride.description: Optional. When absent the environment's period applies, and when that is absent the framework default does. Precedence is resolved by a semantic check, not here.

executionLimitOverrides.description: Optional, and every member is optional, but an empty object is rejected: a declared override that overrides nothing reads as intent that was never expressed.

connectorRefs.description: Names connector configurations that apply in this environment. Names only: a connector's endpoint and credential are external references declared in the connector configuration, never restated here (SEC-013).

approvalPolicyOverride.description: A binding may raise the approval bar for production. It cannot lower the self-approval prohibition, which is why selfApprovalPermitted is absent from this object rather than present and constrained (SEC-016).

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Constrained so an identifier cannot carry arbitrary text, and English by construction (FR-03, CON-01).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC, Z-suffixed. The pattern is present because format is an annotation by default.

observationPeriod.description: An end that precedes its start is rejected by a semantic check; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values (FR-28).
